body.name: Redundant-message rank-boundary diagnostic
body.construction: Take \(K_{00}>0\) and choose \(V_i\in L_2(P_\xi)\) with \(P_\xi[U_{i0}V_i]=0\) and \(P_\xi[V_i^2]=1\). Set \(U_{i1}^{(\delta)}=U_{i0}+\delta V_i\). Projection on \(U_{i0}\) gives coefficient one, residual energy \(\rho_1=\delta^2\), and conditioned field \(H_{i1}=H_{i0}+|\delta|Z_{i1}^{\circ}\).
